english: 36. A person who listens to this story of the propitiation of the Lord of Śoṇagiri performed by the daughter of the King of Mountains shall get rid of enemies (such as lust, anger etc.) and easily attain heavenly pleasures and liberation.” FOOTNOTES AND REFERENCES: The text uses terms of Śivāgama. Hence the reading should have been Pidhāna ‘concealment’ which is one of the five powers of Śiva enlisted here; Vidhāna ‘arrangement’ is already included in sṛṣṭi-sthiti ‘creation and sustenance’ and as such is superfluous.
